svg.title: yashwant938: 196 public contributions in 2026
svg.desc: Contribution calendar for yashwant938, January through December 2026. GitHub's public profile reports 196 contributions. Updated 2026-11-04. Columns are weeks and rows run Sunday through Saturday. Crimson shades preserve GitHub's contribution levels. Each known day has its exact count in a title. Future dates are neutral; dates absent from the input are identified as unavailable. A decorative neon snake eats red tiles with a growing tail and an eaten-tile counter. The grid refills each round; the actual contribution values never change.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.aria-label: A neon snake eats red tiles; the grid refills each round
